standard_prerequisites.use: Gives surjectivity of the pullback map p^* directly, since a vector bundle is a flat morphism with affine space fibres; the injectivity computation is what the counted span supplies. The affine fibres lemma is claimed separately as S14-algebra-pullback-affine-fibres.

standard_prerequisites.name: The relation between the divisor of a section and the twisting sheaf, and restriction to an open
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Divisors, label divisors-lemma-characterize-OD (proof line 7092); Same chapter chow.tex, label lemma-restrict-to-open (proof line 7104)
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies O_P(D) with O_P(1) for the effective Cartier divisor cut out by the section, and describes the kernel of the restriction of Chow groups to the complement of D as the cycles supported on D.

standard_prerequisites.name: The projective space bundle formula, the description of the Gysin pullback, and the vanishing of the top cap on the bundle
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter chow.tex, labels lemma-chow-ring-projective-bundle (proof line 7106), lemma-relative-effective-cartier (proof line 7112) and lemma-pushforward-cap-c1 (proof lines 7113 and 7122)
standard_prerequisites.use: Writes a cycle on D through the powers of the first Chern class of the restriction of the twisting sheaf, converts that expression into powers on P, and then observes that the top power cap vanishes on the projective bundle of rank one higher, forcing all the classes to be zero. The bundle formula is claimed separately as S14-algebra-projective-bundle-formula.

core_obligations: Set up the projective bundle of the direct sum of E with the structure sheaf and the section corresponding to the second summand: let P be that projective bundle with its twisting sheaf, let s be the section corresponding to (0,1), let D be its zero scheme, and note that the restriction of the bundle to D with the restricted twisting sheaf is exactly the projective bundle of E, that D is an effective Cartier divisor with O_P(D) = O_P(1), and that the complement of D is isomorphic to the vector bundle E (proof lines 7078-7095).
Surjectivity is immediate from the flat pullback lemma since a vector bundle has affine space fibres (proof lines 7078-7079).

Injectivity: if p^*alpha = 0 then pi^*alpha lies in the kernel of the restriction to the complement of D, hence is the pushforward of a cycle beta on D; writing beta through the projective bundle formula on D and converting the expression into powers of the first Chern class on P shows that pi^*alpha equals a sum of caps of powers up to the top power, and since the rank of E direct sum O_X is one higher, the vanishing statement for the top cap forces alpha and all the intermediate classes to vanish (proof lines 7096-7123).
proof_roadmap: Realise the vector bundle as the complement of the zero scheme of a section of the projective bundle of E direct sum O_X (proof lines 7078-7095).
Surjectivity from the affine space fibration (proof lines 7078-7079).
Injectivity by describing the kernel of restriction to the complement through the projective bundle formula on the divisor and the vanishing of the top cap (proof lines 7096-7123).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that pullback along the vector bundle associated to a finite locally free sheaf of rank r is an isomorphism from the Chow groups of the base onto the Chow groups of the bundle, shifted by r (statement lines 7061-7075, tag 02TY). Surjectivity is a citation of the affine space fibration lemma, but injectivity needs a real construction: the vector bundle is realised as the complement of the zero scheme of a carefully chosen section of the projective bundle of E direct sum the structure sheaf, a vanishing class is shown to come from the divisor, that divisor class is expanded through the projective space bundle formula, and the resulting expression is contradicted by the vanishing of the top cap on a bundle of one higher rank. The injectivity argument is the substance, so the claim is H2.
